evals.prompt: turn this into a skill so agents set up tooltips properly: every screen gets a tooltips card to its right with real Alloy Tooltip instances, numbered top to bottom, each info icon annotated 'Tooltip 3 · Fee → see tooltips card', card never wider than the screen, one tall list not a grid, never invent copy, never touch the approved page
evals.expected_output: Places the rule by the step 1 tree, sorts the notes, writes steps with a Why on each rule, and asks the designer about every value the notes leave open instead of filling them in.
expectations: States where the rule belongs (new skill or an existing skill) before writing, with the reason
Takes the card's gap from the designer's written standard or an existing card; asks with a recommended default only if neither has it; never invents a pixel value
Asks the designer no more than about 8 questions, blocking ones first, each with a recommended default
Verifies the Alloy Tooltip variant and property names in the library, or marks them unverified and asks
Every numbered rule carries a Why
Contains none of: reasonably, appropriate, sensible, near, roughly, try to, consider

evals.prompt: make this a skill: when the agent ports a playground to Figma it keeps 'improving' things we already decided, it added a fees column nobody asked for, and it re-adds things I deleted on purpose
evals.expected_output: Recognises design-os-prototype-to-figma already does porting and proposes rules or references there instead of a new skill.
expectations: Lists skills/ and reads design-os-prototype-to-figma before deciding
Proposes edits to design-os-prototype-to-figma rather than a new skill
The 'deleted on purpose' rule names what the agent reads to detect a deletion (for example saved plugin data from the last build), or adds a step that records it
Each incident appears once, not as story, reason and lesson

evals.prompt: my audit skill keeps saying colours have no token when they do. can you fix the skill?
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a revision: runs or describes a baseline, adds the smallest change where the failing step lives, and tests it.
expectations: Edits the existing skill's step or reference, not a new skill
Describes a baseline run showing the failure before the change
Adds a Lessons logged line and moves the oldest to references/lessons-archive.md if there are already 3

evals.prompt: we decided Section Title is the heading style for drawer headers, can you make that a skill?
evals.expected_output: Recognises a single design call and routes it to design-os-design-decisions instead of writing a skill.
expectations: Points to design-os-design-decisions to log the call
